## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## User-visible impact

Describe the behaviour before and after this change.

## Change type

- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Security
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Build / CI / release

## Validation

List the commands run and their actual results.

- [ ] Flutter tests
- [ ] Flutter analyze
- [ ] Firestore/Auth emulator tests (when relevant)
- [ ] Android build/resource verification (when relevant)
- [ ] `git diff --check`

## Security and data

- [ ] No secrets, signing material, debug tokens, or personal data added.
- [ ] Firebase impact is documented.
- [ ] No production Firebase deployment was performed without explicit approval.
- [ ] Data ownership and account isolation are preserved.

## Release and device impact

- [ ] Package ID and signing identity are unchanged, unless specifically reviewed.
- [ ] Version/build number updated when preparing a distributable build.
- [ ] Device behaviour is clearly marked as tested or unverified.
- [ ] Documentation and release notes updated where needed.

## Checklist

- [ ] The PR is focused and has a clear title.
- [ ] Tests cover the changed behaviour.
- [ ] No unrelated formatting or generated files are included.
- [ ] Known limitations are listed.
